name: daily-compile-mobile
description: Capacitor iOS + Android shell for The Daily Compile. Bundles frontend/dist.
//overrides: Advisories against transitive dev tooling that Dependabot cannot fix on its own: every
path runs through @capacitor/assets or @capacitor/cli, both already at their latest
release, so there is no version of them that resolves a patched tree. Dependabot reported
'the available update path still resolves it' and failed the job on a schedule.
None of this ships. These are build-time tools — icon generation and `cap sync` — and the
app bundle is frontend/dist. But they run on a developer machine and in CI against files
from the repo, which is enough reason not to leave a known-vulnerable tar or minimatch in
the tree, and enough to stop a recurring red build from becoming background noise.
all still run. Remove an entry when the upstream dependency catches up.
